user.title: Eufy Cameras
user.description: Install and start the **Eufy Cameras Bridge** add-on from this repository first (Settings → Add-ons). Then enter the bridge host/port. On HA OS / Supervised use your Home Assistant host IP and port 3000 — not 127.0.0.1.

hassio_confirm.title: Eufy Cameras Bridge discovered
hassio_confirm.description: The Eufy Cameras Bridge add-on was found at {host}:{port}. Continue to connect.

mfa.title: Eufy 2FA
mfa.description: Enter the verification code Eufy sent (email/SMS/app).

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Mega bridge. Install/start the Eufy Cameras Bridge add-on, check host/port, and wait until it is running.
error.invalid_auth: Code rejected. Try again, or restart the bridge add-on to request a fresh challenge.

abort.already_configured: This Mega bridge is already configured.
